_comment: Atlas Growth UK extensions :: UNRATED variant of recover-baretype-extensions-uk-config.json — same scope gate and same type/name rules, but for rows with NO review data and a live website instead of the >=5 floor. Needed because a row that fails the allow AND has a blank review_count carries drop_reason not_in_icp, which recover-unrated (scope too_small) never sees (OPEN engine limitation, IMPROVEMENTS 2026-09-20). Generated from the rated config 2026-10-11; keep the two in step. Run: node skills/google-maps-scrape/qualify-leads.js --in <run>/maps/excluded_officp.csv --config clients/atlas-growth/recover-baretype-unrated-extensions-uk-config.json --out <run>/maps/recover-baretype-unrated

qualify_rules._r: 0. RECOVERY SCOPE GATE — only rows the main pass dropped at its positive allow (drop_reason not_in_icp). A row removed by a deny (hard_off_icp_type / off_icp_primary / name_deny) or the floor (too_small) is refused before any other rule is read; this pass can never re-litigate a deny. CAVEAT (same as every recovery config in this client): pointed at a file with NO drop_reason column, `in` reads an empty string and every row is refused — that is the safe failure.
qualify_rules.label: not_a_recovery_candidate

qualify_rules._r: 1. The bare generic types, PRIMARY only, exact match. 'contractor' and 'builder' are the two Google types a UK general builder most often carries alone; 'remodeler' / 'remodeller' (Google serves the UK spelling too — calibration 2026-10-11: 'Chins Construction | Remodeller') is the generic (non-kitchen, non-bathroom) remodel type; 'building firm' is already a main-pass allow substring and is listed here only so a primary 'Building firm' row dropped for some other allow reason cannot slip away. A row primaried 'Roofing contractor' does NOT match ('roofing contractor' != 'contractor') — that row belongs to the generic name recovery, where its name must claim loft/extension work.
qualify_rules.label: not_bare_generic_primary

qualify_rules._r: UNRATED ONLY — the blank review band (the 1-4 band stays dropped, as in the unrated pass). This pass exists because of the OPEN qualify-leads.js limitation (IMPROVEMENTS 2026-09-20: a recovery pass sees only the MAIN pass's drop reason): a blank-review row that also fails the allow is recorded not_in_icp, never too_small, so recover-unrated cannot reach it and the rated variant of this pass drops it at the floor. Calibration 2026-10-11: 'Mils Development - Loft Conversions & Extensions', 'Design & Build Scotland Ltd', 'Excel Construction' — bare Contractor, no review data, live website — were falling here.
qualify_rules.label: has_review_count

qualify_rules._r: A LIVE WEBSITE is the substitute activity signal, exactly as in recover-unrated-extensions-uk-config.json.
qualify_rules.label: no_website
